checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open hands rest beside body, palms down.
checks.feet: Supine body stays supported while straight legs lower together and return to vertical.
checks.movement: Supine, arms beside torso palms down. Straight legs lower together from vertical to 15 degrees above horizontal over 3.5 seconds, pause 1 second and return over 3.5 seconds. Back remains supported without pelvic curl; low head cushion.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
